head: f
question: Under frozen source population covariances, how much new-task f uncertainty can additional within-task source observations remove, and how much remains due to task-specific functions? This determines whether more same-task labels alone offer a plausible next intervention.
law: Use original144 and native216 full-six-source f A,R,delta on their own public73 bases. Use cached source-noise labels and site lists only;no response outcomes or parameter changes. Recompute H via source block precision. Contrast current H with hypothetical zero-observation-noise coverage of all73 policies on the same six source tasks,exact knowledge of six source coefficient vectors,and exact knowledge of twelve independent coefficient vectors. Exact coefficient scenarios are mathematical information ceilings,not generated data or experiments.
quantities: Report public bank average variance,bank-average level variance,and centered-shape variance for common H,task R,discrepancy delta and total new-task K. Report the maximum model-conditional reducible fraction from more within-task source information. Also condition total new-task K on exact noiseless latent f at fixed policies0/1,without any paid values;this is a covariance bound and not the raw moment filter or KG.
verification: Recomputed current H must reproduce saved native H with absolute/relative1e-8. Exact-six H <= all73-zero-noise H <= current H in PSD order;exact-twelve H <= exact-six H. Exact-two paid conditioning must contract total K. Bank total variance must equal level plus centered shape. A disagreement stops interpretation and detects covariance/site/noise or precision accounting errors.
decision: Use conditional information bounds to choose between further same-task source coverage,independent source-task information,and target adaptation. Do not adopt any model,select source policies,drop tasks,change gates or dispatch experiments. Bounds condition on empirical parameters and cannot establish model correctness,prediction error,task-population calibration or independent decision value. Preserve stopped candidates and Stage113 positive development evidence.
execution: local serial single-thread;cached small JSON only;no server jobs or pulls
